```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

canonical_contrast <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    str_remove_all("^_|_$")
}

find_column <- function(data, candidates, description) {
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(data)]

  if (length(found) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify ", description,
      ". Available columns: ", paste(names(data), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  found[1]
}

flatten_list_columns <- function(data) {
  list_columns <- names(data)[vapply(data, is.list, logical(1))]

  if (length(list_columns) == 0) return(data)

  data %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(list_columns),
        ~ vapply(
          .x,
          function(value) {
            if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0) return("")
            paste(unlist(value, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE), collapse = "; ")
          },
          character(1)
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
read_primary_de <- function(file, molecule, dataset) {
  identifier <- if (molecule == "mRNA") "Gene" else "pre_miRNA"

  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(identifier) %>%
    as_tibble()

  required <- c("logFC", "PValue", "FDR")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(file, " is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  data[[identifier]] <- trimws(as.character(data[[identifier]]))

  data %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = dataset,
      Contrast = params$contrast,
      logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      PValue = as.numeric(PValue),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
      .before = 1
    )
}

read_stability <- function(
    file,
    molecule,
    flag_column
) {
  data <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  identifier_candidates <- if (molecule == "mRNA") {
    c(
      "Gene",
      "gene",
      "gene_symbol",
      "symbol",
      "GeneSymbol",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  } else {
    c(
      "pre_miRNA",
      "pre_mirna",
      "miRNA",
      "mirna",
      "Gene",
      "X",
      "...1"
    )
  }

  identifier <- if (molecule == "mRNA") {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  identifier_column <- find_column(
    data,
    identifier_candidates,
    "feature identifier"
  )

  names(data)[
    names(data) == identifier_column
  ] <- identifier

  contrast_column <- find_column(
    data,
    c(
      "Contrast",
      "contrast",
      "Comparison",
      "comparison"
    ),
    "contrast column"
  )

  names(data)[
    names(data) == contrast_column
  ] <- "Contrast"

  if (!flag_column %in% names(data)) {
    stop(
      "Stability flag ",
      flag_column,
      " not found in ",
      file,
      ". Available columns: ",
      paste(
        names(data),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  data[[identifier]] <- trimws(
    as.character(
      data[[identifier]]
    )
  )

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast = canonical_contrast(
        Contrast
      ),

      selected_stability_flag = as_flag(
        .data[[flag_column]]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast ==
        canonical_contrast(
          params$contrast
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(identifier),
      Contrast,
      selected_stability_flag
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

build_validated_table <- function(
    dataset,
    molecule,
    primary_file,
    stability_file,
    flag_column
) {
  identifier <- if (molecule == "mRNA") {
    "Gene"
  } else {
    "pre_miRNA"
  }

  primary <- read_primary_de(
    primary_file,
    molecule,
    dataset
  )

  stability <- read_stability(
    stability_file,
    molecule,
    flag_column
  )

  joined <- primary %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stability,
      by = c(
        identifier,
        "Contrast"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bootstrap_stable = dplyr::coalesce(
        selected_stability_flag,
        FALSE
      ),

      primary_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,

      validated_significant =
        primary_significant &
        bootstrap_stable,

      Direction = dplyr::case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "No direction"
      )
    )

  list(
    all = joined,

    validated = joined %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        validated_significant
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
input_files <- list(
  CRC = list(
    mRNA_primary = file.path(
      params$original_crc_de_dir,
      paste0(params$contrast, ".csv")
    ),
    mRNA_stability = params$crc_mrna_stability_file,
    pre_miRNA_primary = file.path(
      params$crc_mirna_primary_dir,
      paste0(params$contrast, ".csv")
    ),
    pre_miRNA_stability = params$crc_mirna_stability_file
  ),

  UCEC = list(
    mRNA_primary = file.path(
      params$original_ucec_de_dir,
      paste0(params$contrast, ".csv")
    ),
    mRNA_stability = params$ucec_mrna_stability_file,
    pre_miRNA_primary = file.path(
      params$ucec_mirna_primary_dir,
      paste0(params$contrast, ".csv")
    ),
    pre_miRNA_stability = params$ucec_mirna_stability_file
  )
)

all_input_files <- unlist(input_files)
missing_files <- all_input_files[!file.exists(all_input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing files:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

analysis_data <- list()

for (dataset_name in c("CRC", "UCEC")) {
  files <- input_files[[dataset_name]]

  analysis_data[[dataset_name]] <- list(
    mRNA = build_validated_table(
      dataset_name,
      "mRNA",
      files$mRNA_primary,
      files$mRNA_stability,
      params$mrna_stability_flag_column
    ),

    pre_miRNA = build_validated_table(
      dataset_name,
      "pre_miRNA",
      files$pre_miRNA_primary,
      files$pre_miRNA_stability,
      params$mirna_stability_flag_column
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
shared_mirna <- inner_join(
  analysis_data$CRC$pre_miRNA$validated %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      CRC_logFC = logFC,
      CRC_FDR = FDR
    ),

  analysis_data$UCEC$pre_miRNA$validated %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      UCEC_logFC = logFC,
      UCEC_FDR = FDR
    ),

  by = "pre_miRNA"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction_consistent =
      sign(CRC_logFC) == sign(UCEC_logFC),

    mean_logFC =
      rowMeans(cbind(CRC_logFC, UCEC_logFC)),

    Direction = case_when(
      mean_logFC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
      mean_logFC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Direction_consistent) %>%
  distinct(pre_miRNA, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(pre_miRNA)

n_shared <- n_distinct(shared_mirna$pre_miRNA)

if (n_shared != params$expected_shared_mirna_count) {
  stop(
    "Expected ", params$expected_shared_mirna_count,
    " shared bootstrap-validated pre-miRNAs, but found ", n_shared, "."
  )
}

write.csv(
  shared_mirna,
  file.path(table_dir, "six_shared_bootstrap_validated_pre_miRNAs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  shared_mirna,
  caption = "Six shared bootstrap-validated pre-miRNAs."
)
```

```{r}
make_mature_candidates <- function(precursors) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(precursors),
      function(precursor) {
        mature_base <- precursor %>%
          trimws() %>%
          str_replace("^hsa-mir", "hsa-miR")

        mature <- if (str_detect(mature_base, "-(3p|5p)$")) {
          mature_base
        } else {
          c(
            paste0(mature_base, "-5p"),
            paste0(mature_base, "-3p")
          )
        }

        tibble(
          pre_miRNA = precursor,
          mature_query = mature
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    distinct()
}

mature_candidates <- make_mature_candidates(
  shared_mirna$pre_miRNA
)

write.csv(
  mature_candidates,
  file.path(multimir_dir, "six_shared_pre_miRNA_mature_candidates.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
query_one_mirna <- function(pre_miRNA, mature_query) {
  message("Querying multiMiR: ", mature_query)

  result <- tryCatch(
    multiMiR::get_multimir(
      mirna = mature_query,
      table = "validated",
      summary = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Failed: ", mature_query, " | ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (
    is.null(result) ||
    is.null(result@data) ||
    nrow(result@data) == 0
  ) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  result@data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      pre_miRNA = pre_miRNA,
      mature_query = mature_query,
      .before = 1
    )
}

multimir_cache <- file.path(
```

```{r}
run_enrichment <- function(correction_method) {
  if (!params$run_gprofiler) return(tibble())

  result <- gprofiler2::gost(
    query = enrichment_genes,
    organism = params$organism,
    ordered_query = FALSE,
    multi_query = FALSE,
    significant = FALSE,
    exclude_iea = FALSE,
    measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
    evcodes = TRUE,
    user_threshold = 1,
    correction_method = correction_method,
    domain_scope = params$domain_scope,
    custom_bg = shared_background,
    sources = params$enrichment_sources,
    highlight = FALSE
  )

  if (
    is.null(result) ||
    is.null(result$result) ||
    nrow(result$result) == 0
  ) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  result$result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      Query = "Genes connected to six shared pre-miRNAs",
      Correction = correction_method,
      Significant = p_value <= params$fdr_cutoff,
      .before = 1
    )
}

enrichment_gscs <- run_enrichment("g_SCS")
enrichment_fdr <- run_enrichment("fdr")

enrichment_results <- bind_rows(
  enrichment_gscs,
  enrichment_fdr
)

enrichment_export <- flatten_list_columns(
  enrichment_results
)

write.csv(
  enrichment_export,
  file.path(enrichment_dir, "all_enrichment_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  enrichment_export %>% filter(Significant),
  file.path(enrichment_dir, "significant_enrichment_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plot_enrichment <- function(
    data,
    correction,
    title,
    output_file
) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Correction == correction,
      Significant
    ) %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    arrange(p_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = params$top_terms_per_source) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10_p = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-300)),
      term_label = paste0(
        source,
        ": ",
        str_trunc(term_name, 75)
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = factor(
        term_label,
        levels = rev(unique(term_label))
      )
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    message("No significant ", correction, " enrichment terms.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(neglog10_p, term_label)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = intersection_size,
        color = neglog10_p
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle =
        "Shared bootstrap-validated DEG targets of six shared pre-miRNAs",
      x = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
      y = NULL,
      size = "Target genes",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p"))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  ggsave(
    output_file,
    p,
    width = 10,
    height = max(6, 0.28 * nrow(plot_data)),
    device = "svg",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```
